res: piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 16

traits.d: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the xorn doesn't disturb the material it moves through.
The xorn has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.
The xorn can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 ft. of it.

actions.d: The xorn makes three claw attacks and one bite attack.
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

tips: Сопротивление урону: piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons — вполовину менее эффективно, предпочтите другой тип.
Слабый спасбросок: Ловкость / Интеллект / Мудрость / Харизму (+0) — эффекты и заклинания на эту характеристику с высокой вероятностью пройдут.
Мультиатака — наносит несколько ударов за ход. Эффекты обездвиживания/оглушения особенно ценны против него.
